obs: California Motor Transport Co. v. Trucking Unlimited
"The right of petition is one of the freedoms protected by the Bill of Rights, and we cannot, of course, lightly impute to Congress an intent to invade these freedoms."
California Motor Transport Co. v. Trucking Unlimited

"To hold that the government retains the power to act in this representative capacity and yet hold, at the same time, that the people cannot freely inform the government of their wishes would impute to the Sherman Act a purpose to regulate, not business activity, but political activity, a purpose which \"would have no basis whatever in the legislative history of that Act.""
